correctness.rationale: The source Laplacian reduces exactly to Johnson L_J; Green shell divergences give positive radial differences and explicit lower potentials. A complete sign classification includes a proof of the exceptional sign by a bounded tail-ratio argument. The degree-two dual potential solves the incidence divergence equations symbolically and evaluates the exact l1 norm. The diagonal and cycle complement are computed explicitly. An independent exact-rational checker matched 54 orbit solves, 9 grounded full-graph solves and arbitrary-parameter polynomial identities; finite checks are not substituted for the analytic steps.

value.rationale: Adjacent ranks form a fundamental Boolean-lattice truncation that is edge-transitive but vertex-biregular. Exact endpoint operator norms throughout a two-parameter family establish a fixed-rank bounded regime versus proportional-rank linear regime with coefficient 2alpha(1-alpha). This addresses intrinsic graph-free-space geometry, not an isolated small numerical example or a formal relabeling of full-cube results.
